'''Frang''', better known as '''Frang the Toothless''', was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] was known for being particularly clever, and he negotiated a deal with the [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrips]] who inhabited [[Savrip Island]], a small island off the coast of the the larger island of [[Avilatan]]&mdash;the Savrips permitted Frang to dump his enemies on Savrip Island in return for a steady [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supply. The deal became a local legend in the area, and it was said that both Frang and the Savrips benefited greatly from their arrangement.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frang was mentioned in the Codex entry for Savrip Island in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
